newsitem.title: USA: Arrow International sees Q2 sales growth.
newsitem.headline: Arrow International sees Q2 sales growth.

text.p: Arrow International Inc said Thursday it sees its second-quarter sales growth on par with its first-quarter sales growth of 8.6 percent.
The company said the growth would come assuming a stable currency, and that new products will accelerate the sales growth for the second half of the year.
Officials from the company were not immediately available to comment.

The company reported Thursday its sales rose 8.6 percent to $59.2 million from $54.5 million in the year-ago period. The sales resulted in earnings of $0.36 per share for the quarter, equal to the same quarter last year.
